Structures A and B of the same molecule share atom order and one Cartesian frame (angstrom). The table gives the total PBE0+MBD force on every atom at B (eV/angstrom), with F_i = −∂E/∂r_i. Along the straight path r_i(λ) = r_i(A) + λ[r_i(B) − r_i(A)], what is dE/dλ at λ = 1 (that is, at B), in eV? Do not realign, mass-weight or normalize the displacement.

选项：
A. -0.9140 eV
B. 5.9171 eV
C. 11.8341 eV
D. 21.4197 eV
